verses.text_urhobo: Ọmọke vwọ wanre, omuidi rẹ ovie rẹ Ijipt kugbe okakemu rọye da chọ urhi rẹ ọrovwayen ovie rẹ Ijipt na.
verses.text_romanized: omoke vwo wanre omuidi re ovie re ijipt kugbe okakemu roye da cho urhi re orovwayen ovie re ijipt na

verses.text_urhobo: Ivun de miovwo Fero kpahe inotu rọye ivẹ na, omuidi na kugbe okakemu na,
verses.text_romanized: ivun de miovwo fero kpahe inotu roye ive na omuidi na kugbe okakemu na

verses.text_urhobo: o de mu ayen phihọ uwodi vwẹ uwevwi rẹ onotu rẹ idugbu na, vwẹ evun rẹ uwodi re ji mu Josẹf phihọ na.
verses.text_romanized: o de mu ayen phiho uwodi vwe uwevwi re onotu re idugbu na vwe evun re uwodi re ji mu josef phiho na

verses.text_urhobo: Onotu rẹ idugbu na da vwẹ ayen kẹ Josẹf, kọye vwẹ ẹro te ayen; ayen da rhe dia uwodi na emerha.
verses.text_romanized: onotu re idugbu na da vwe ayen ke josef koye vwe ero te ayen ayen da rhe dia uwodi na emerha

verses.text_urhobo: Ason ọvo ayen ivẹ na da vwerhẹ evwerhẹ - omuidi na kugbe okakemu na rẹ ovie rẹ Ijipt re mu phihọ uwodi na, dohwo devwerhẹ rọye, dohwo dotọ rọye.
verses.text_romanized: ason ovo ayen ive na da vwerhe evwerhe omuidi na kugbe okakemu na re ovie re ijipt re mu phiho uwodi na dohwo devwerhe roye dohwo doto roye

verses.text_urhobo: Ri Josẹf vwo bru ayen rhe irhiọke re mrẹ ayen, ayen de muomahọ.
verses.text_romanized: ri josef vwo bru ayen rhe irhioke re mre ayen ayen de muomaho

verses.text_urhobo: Ọ da nọ inotu ri Fero na re mu phihọ uwodi vwẹ uwevwi rẹ onini rọye na, Die nẹrhẹ ovwan muomahọ nonẹ?
verses.text_romanized: o da no inotu ri fero na re mu phiho uwodi vwe uwevwi re onini roye na die nerhe ovwan muomaho none

verses.text_urhobo: Ayen da ta kẹ, Avwanre vwerhẹ evwerhẹ, a rha mrẹ ohwo rọ faotọ rọye kẹ avwanre-e. Josẹf da ta kẹ ayen; Ọ dia Ọghẹnẹ re faotọ rẹ evwerhẹ? Gba ta kẹ vwẹ, Me rẹ wẹ.
verses.text_romanized: ayen da ta ke avwanre vwerhe evwerhe a rha mre ohwo ro faoto roye ke avwanre e josef da ta ke ayen o dia oghene re faoto re evwerhe gba ta ke vwe me re we

verses.text_urhobo: Kọye omuidi na da ta evwerhẹ rọye ki Josẹf, ọ da ta kẹ, Vwẹ evwerhẹ mẹ na urhe ri vain da obaro Me,
verses.text_romanized: koye omuidi na da ta evwerhe roye ki josef o da ta ke vwe evwerhe me na urhe ri vain da obaro me

verses.text_urhobo: vwẹ enu ri vain na eghọn erha da herọ; rọ ghwa vwọ kpa ipho na, ọ da ghwa mọ ibi, siẹvuọvo na ibi na da ghwa vware.
verses.text_romanized: vwe enu ri vain na eghon erha da hero ro ghwa vwo kpa ipho na o da ghwa mo ibi sievuovo na ibi na da ghwa vware

verses.text_urhobo: Yẹ uko ri Fero rhe vwe obọ; Me da reyọ otie na mi de mi ayen phihọ uko ri Fero na, mi de mu uko na phihọ obọ ri Fero.
verses.text_romanized: ye uko ri fero rhe vwe obo me da reyo otie na mi de mi ayen phiho uko ri fero na mi de mu uko na phiho obo ri fero

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin Josẹf da ta kẹ, Ọnana otọ rọye: eghọn erha na eye ẹdẹ erha;
verses.text_romanized: etiyin josef da ta ke onana oto roye eghon erha na eye ede erha

verses.text_urhobo: vwẹ evun rẹ ẹdẹ erha na Fero kọ kpare uyovwi wẹn kpenu kọ rhoma phi we phihọ edia wẹn, ku wo mu uko phihọ obọ ri Fero kirobo ri wo ruẹ jovwo, ọke ru wọ vwọ omuidi rọye.
verses.text_romanized: vwe evun re ede erha na fero ko kpare uyovwi wen kpenu ko rhoma phi we phiho edia wen ku wo mu uko phiho obo ri fero kirobo ri wo rue jovwo oke ru wo vwo omuidi roye

verses.text_urhobo: Ẹkẹvuọvo karo ovwẹ, ọke ro de yovwi kẹ wẹ, re wo ji ru ẹse na kẹ vwẹ, Me rẹ wẹ, re wọ fan odẹ mẹ ki Fero, re o si vwẹ nẹ uwevwi nana.
verses.text_romanized: ekevuovo karo ovwe oke ro de yovwi ke we re wo ji ru ese na ke vwe me re we re wo fan ode me ki fero re o si vwe ne uwevwi nana

verses.text_urhobo: Kidie vwẹ uyota e cho vwe nẹ otọ ri Hibru rhe; vwẹ obonẹ na mi ji ru emu rọ chọre re vwo mu vwe phihọ evun rẹ ẹmwa na-a.
verses.text_romanized: kidie vwe uyota e cho vwe ne oto ri hibru rhe vwe obone na mi ji ru emu ro chore re vwo mu vwe phiho evun re emwa na a

verses.text_urhobo: Ọke rẹ olori rẹ ekakemu na vwọ mrẹ nẹ ọ fan otọ rọye yoyovwi, ọ da ta ki Josẹf, Me je vwerhẹ evwerhẹ rhe: ibere rẹ ikara erha da enu rẹ uyovwi mẹ,
verses.text_romanized: oke re olori re ekakemu na vwo mre ne o fan oto roye yoyovwi o da ta ki josef me je vwerhe evwerhe rhe ibere re ikara erha da enu re uyovwi me

verses.text_urhobo: ọ rọ ka obenu ejobi da vọn vẹ emu ra kakere ki Fero, ẹkẹvuọvo ephran ke sohrọ ria vwẹ enu rẹ uyovwi mẹ.
verses.text_romanized: o ro ka obenu ejobi da von ve emu ra kakere ki fero ekevuovo ephran ke sohro ria vwe enu re uyovwi me

verses.text_urhobo: Josẹf da kpahe, Ọnana ye otọ rọye: ibere erha eye ẹdẹ erha;
verses.text_romanized: josef da kpahe onana ye oto roye ibere erha eye ede erha

verses.text_urhobo: vwẹ evun rẹ ẹdẹ rẹ erha na Fero kọ kpare uyovwi wẹn nu we oma; ko churu we si urhe; ephran ke cha sohrọ uvwo wẹn re.
verses.text_romanized: vwe evun re ede re erha na fero ko kpare uyovwi wen nu we oma ko churu we si urhe ephran ke cha sohro uvwo wen re

verses.text_urhobo: Vwẹ ẹdẹ rẹ erha, rọ dia eduvwiẹ ri Fero, o de chere emu kẹ idibo rọye ejobi, ọ da kpare uyovwi rẹ onotu rẹ omuidi na kpenu kugbe uyovwi rẹ onotu rọ kakemu na kpenu vwẹ usun rẹ idibo rọye na.
verses.text_romanized: vwe ede re erha ro dia eduvwie ri fero o de chere emu ke idibo roye ejobi o da kpare uyovwi re onotu re omuidi na kpenu kugbe uyovwi re onotu ro kakemu na kpenu vwe usun re idibo roye na

verses.text_urhobo: Ọ da rhoma reyọ onotu rẹ omuidi na phihọ ako rẹ iruo rọye o de mu uko phihọ obọ ri Fero,
verses.text_romanized: o da rhoma reyo onotu re omuidi na phiho ako re iruo roye o de mu uko phiho obo ri fero

verses.text_urhobo: ẹkẹvuọvo o de churu onotu rọ kakemu na si, kirobo ri Josẹf fan otọ rẹ evwerhẹ na kẹ ayen.
verses.text_romanized: ekevuovo o de churu onotu ro kakemu na si kirobo ri josef fan oto re evwerhe na ke ayen

verses.text_urhobo: Yẹ ẹkẹvuọvo onotu rẹ omuidi na gbe sa karophihọ Josẹfu-u, o da chọẹro.
verses.text_romanized: ye ekevuovo onotu re omuidi na gbe sa karophiho josefu u o da choero

headings.text_urhobo: Josẹf fan otọ rẹ Evwerhẹ rẹ Ohwo ra Kanre na
headings.text_romanized: josef fan oto re evwerhe re ohwo ra kanre na
